# Dictionary

<!-- ste: descriptive | generated by zig build gen-dictionary from docs/dictionary/*.txt -->

This page is the project dictionary for the [Style Guide](Style-Guide-STE). The linter `zig build lint-docs` reads the same files. The lists are the work of this project. They do not copy the dictionary of ASD-STE100.

## Restricted words

Approved words that have one meaning in this project.

| Word | Meaning or replacement |
| --- | --- |
| support | technical verb, "provide an implementation of a protocol feature" |
| handle | prefer "process" or "receive"; "handle" is also a technical noun for an opaque identifier |
| return | technical verb for the value a function gives back |
| free | technical verb for releasing memory |

## Project word list

Words that this project does not use in prose, with the replacement (rule 1.1).

| Word | Meaning or replacement |
| --- | --- |
| should | must (when it is a requirement) or "We recommend that" (when it is advice) |
| shall | must |
| may | can |
| ensure | make sure |
| ensures | makes sure |
| however | but |
| utilize | use |
| utilizes | uses |
| via | through, or with |
| session | (forbidden: the protocol is stateless; describe the request or the stream) |
| following | these, or that follows |
| implement | write, or provide |
| implements | provides |
